title: Revisiting G29.862─0.0044: A jet cavity disrupted by an outflow in a likely young stellar object wide binary system
question: Whether the near-IR features in YSO-G29 arise from a single source or from an unresolved system of YSOs and/or complex protostellar dynamics.

recipe.goal: Reduce and analyze Gemini-NIFS near-IR IFU cubes and map H2 and Br-gamma emission
recipe.method: Reduce NIFS spectra using Gemini IRAF tasks, create 3''x3'' cubes with 0.05'' sampling, fit continuum to each spaxel, integrate over full line profiles of Br-gamma and H2 1-0 S(1), and compute H2/Br-gamma ratio map.

recipe.goal: Image JVLA 10 GHz radio continuum, measure flux density, and classify radio source
recipe.method: Calibrate JVLA visibilities with CASA pipeline, manually flag RFI, image with tclean (Briggs ROBUST = 0.25), integrate flux within 50 uJy/beam contour, extrapolate to 5.8 GHz to compare with L_bol, and compute Lyman continuum photon flux.
key_parameters: ROBUST = 0.25, beam = 0.42'' x 0.17'', rms = 6 uJy beam^-1
assumptions: Spectral index alpha = 0.6 for ionised jet/knot and alpha = -0.1 for optically thin HC/UC HII region; D = 6.2 kpc; T_e = 10^4 K, a = 1

recipe.goal: Map ALMA CO isotopologues and derive physical parameters of the southern molecular outflow
recipe.method: Generate moment 0 and channel maps of 12CO, 13CO, and C18O J=2-1; exclude self-absorbed velocities (97.2-102.0 km s^-1); integrate blueshifted (87.6-96.0 km s^-1) and redshifted (102-108 km s^-1) 12CO emission; compute CO column density, outflow mass, dynamical time, mass outflow rate, momentum, and momentum rate for the southern redshifted lobe.
key_parameters: Blue velocity range: 87.6 - 96.0 km s^-1; Red velocity range: 102 - 108 km s^-1; Excluded range: 97.2 - 102.0 km s^-1; Systemic velocity: 101 km s^-1; Outflow length L ~ 0.06 pc; Integrated intensity W ~ 0.5 Jy beam^-1 km s^-1
assumptions: LTE excitation temperature T_ex = 20 K, abundance ratio [CO/H2] = 10^-4, mean molecular weight mu_H2 = 2.72, distance = 6.2 kpc

recipe.goal: Estimate bolometric luminosity from archival mid-IR to mm SED
recipe.method: Compile fluxes from allWISE (22 um), Hi-GAL (70-500 um), ATLASGAL (870 um), and BGPS (1100 um); perform linear interpolation between bands; integrate area under the curve to obtain bolometric flux and luminosity.
key_parameters: Wavelength range: 22 um to 1100 um; zero point f_0 = 8.36 Jy at 22 um

recipe.goal: Characterize chemical inventory, rotational temperatures, and gas mass of the main dust core
recipe.method: Extract spectra from a circular region at the 1.3 mm continuum peak across 8 spws from ALMA projects 2021.1.00311.S and 2015.1.01312.S; identify lines using SDAS (CDMS/JPL); construct rotational diagrams for 6 species to fit T_rot; calculate core gas mass from 1.3 mm continuum flux.
assumptions: LTE and optically thin emission for rotational diagrams; thermal coupling of gas and dust with T_dust = 361 K (from CH3CN); dust opacity per gram of matter kappa_nu = 0.013 cm^2 g^-1 at 1.3 mm; distance d = 6.2 kpc
